services.title: Artik Lab
services.description: Artik Lab helps companies and business functions choose, govern and deliver the first useful use of AI: process mapping, business cases, team training, data analysis and controlled prototypes.

services.title: AI management consulting
services.description: AI is not software to install: it is a management capability to build. Artik Lab helps leadership decide where to use it, where to stop, which processes to redesign and which skills must remain inside the company.

services.title: Agentic data analysis
services.description: Agentic data analysis does not produce charts to archive: it finds signals in already available data, connects them to a decision and states where the model is not worth building.

services.title: AI applications atlas
services.description: A public map of concrete examples to recognise where artificial intelligence can reduce time, errors, risk or decision delays in company workflows.

services.title: Corporate AI FAQ
services.description: A public question set for owners, leaders and business functions choosing between consulting, courses, data analysis, technical software and the AI applications Atlas.

services.title: Technical AI software
services.description: Artik Lab develops advanced software for clients when the problem cannot be solved by a dashboard or a standard business application: technical calculations, mathematical models, operational data, expert rules and workflows that need to become verifiable.

services.title: Corporate AI courses: choose the right path
services.description: Corporate AI course catalog: introductory, managerial, operational and technical paths designed with DTR around roles, workflows and expected outcomes.
